Remark
[Plane-wave characterization of hyperbolicity] ↗ def:hyperbolic-system ↗ def:traveling-wave-plane-wave 1. ch7:7.3.1-rem-1\group Hyperbolic Systems

For constant matrices and $\mathbf f=0$, a plane wave \[ \mathbf u(x,t)=\mathbf v(y\cdot x-\sigma t) \tag {4} \] satisfies \[ \left(-\sigma I+\sum _{j=1}^ny_jB_j\right)\mathbf v'=0. \] Thus $\sigma $ is an eigenvalue of $\mathbf B(y)=\sum _jy_jB_j$ and $\mathbf v'$ an eigenvector. Hyperbolicity supplies $m$ independent real plane-wave modes; for $|y|=1$, the eigenvalues are their wave speeds.
